# Protect Our Poconos

> Community information about data-center proposals, transmission projects, local planning decisions, and public participation in Pennsylvania's Pocono region.

The site focuses on Pike and Monroe counties. Project records distinguish documented proposals, related infrastructure, watchlist sites, and unverified community rumors. A documented proposal is not necessarily approved or under construction. Review each page's linked original records and dates; project details and meeting schedules can change. Official government and utility records take precedence over reporting and explicitly labeled community sources. Tip submissions and email signup are not currently available.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://protectourpoconos.com/): Overview of local development, issues, and participation.
- [Local Projects](https://protectourpoconos.com/projects/): Project records, evidence categories, source links, and milestones.
- [Resources](https://protectourpoconos.com/resources/): Official documents, township records, glossary, and agency directory.
- [The Issues](https://protectourpoconos.com/issues/): Forests, water, power, noise, community character, and jobs; established facts and project-specific uncertainties.
- [News & Updates](https://protectourpoconos.com/news/): Curated external reporting and updates, labeled by source.
- [Take Action](https://protectourpoconos.com/take-action/): Meetings, officials, and public participation guidance. Confirm dates with the official source before attending.
- [About](https://protectourpoconos.com/about/): What this project is, how information is verified, and how project statuses are defined.

## Optional

- [XML sitemap](https://protectourpoconos.com/sitemap.xml): Canonical page inventory, regenerated with each publication.

- [FAQ](https://protectourpoconos.com/faq/): Answers about local proposals, power, water, jobs and participation.
